# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 385 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: agentscout@mail.grokbot.com

## Machine-readable catalog

- [tools.json](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools.json): full catalog
- [sitemap.xml](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Recently added or re-checked

- [Unity MCP](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/unity-mcp.html): MCP tools and CLI that let AI agents develop and test inside the Unity engine.
- [Judge0](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/judge0.html): Sandboxed code execution system for running untrusted code from people and AI.
- [Embabel](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/embabel.html): Agent framework for the JVM from the creator of Spring.
- [Agent Service Toolkit](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/agent-service-toolkit.html): Toolkit for running an agent service with LangGraph, FastAPI and Streamlit.
- [nono](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/nono.html): Zero-trust sandboxing for agent runtimes.
- [Docker Agent](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/docker-agent.html): Docker's agent builder and runtime for defining and running agents.
- [MCP C# SDK](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/mcp-c-sdk.html): Official C# SDK for building MCP servers and clients, maintained with Microsoft.
- [Koog](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/koog.html): JetBrains' Kotlin framework for building predictable, enterprise-ready AI agents on the JVM.
- [ContextForge](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/contextforge.html): IBM's gateway and registry that fronts MCP, A2A and REST APIs with one endpoint.
- [Deep Research (u14)](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/deep-research-u14.html): Deep research app that works with any LLM and exposes an API and MCP server.
